title: Monthly commodity gap for CAD and NOK
question: Does the commodity gap signal, rebalanced monthly with all other settings unchanged, show a real effect under the gauntlet?
prior_trials_note: The weekly version and its 6-variant sweep in EXP-0002 count as 12 trials on this signal.
what_would_change_our_mind: Passing at least 4 of 5 reality tests would make the slower signal worth a forward test. Fewer than 4 retires HYP-0008.
already_seen: Partly. The monthly variant's full-sample Sharpe (0.26) was seen in the EXP-0002 sweep. Its gauntlet results have not been seen.
